breaks.name: A changed fingerprint keeps its status
caught_by: test-check.R: a variant of an output that isn't Human approved, or a stale bundle, is refused

breaks.name: A part is dropped from the serialised form (core)
caught_by: test-contract.R: plotly_3d: sensitivity

breaks.name: A part is dropped from the serialised form (plotly_3d presets)
caught_by: test-contract.R: plotly_3d: sensitivity

breaks.name: Negative-zero normalisation is skipped
caught_by: test-normalise.R: negative zero loses its sign but real negatives do not

breaks.name: An agent's approval with no note is accepted
caught_by: test-runner.R: list and diff work; approval requires a note and rejection stores it

breaks.name: An agent's rejection with no note is accepted
caught_by: test-status.R: every row of the transition table holds

breaks.name: An agent writes Human approved
caught_by: test-check.R: an agent approves a platform variant from a bundle, with a note

breaks.name: A view is rendered from another output than the one hashed
caught_by: test-contract.R: base_graphics: completeness

breaks.name: A view is rendered from the declared object, not the hashed build
caught_by: test-contract.R: base_graphics: completeness

breaks.name: Views are rendered for outputs that are not Unreviewed
caught_by: test-runner.R: views are rendered for Unreviewed outputs only

breaks.name: Approved views are not kept for comparison
caught_by: test-check.R: the release audit compares fresh views with those kept at approval

breaks.name: A new fingerprint keeps the old agent note
caught_by: test-runner.R: running records Unreviewed, unchanged re-runs keep status, changes reset it

breaks.name: A case whose expectations fail still updates the review state
caught_by: test-runner.R: breaking the line fails the expectation and leaves review state untouched

breaks.name: A case with no expectations counts as passed
caught_by: test-runner.R: a case with no expectations does not count as passed

breaks.name: A part skips the common normalisation
caught_by: test-types.R: every part goes through the common normalisation

breaks.name: Absolute paths are not tokenised
caught_by: test-normalise.R: absolute paths become tokens

breaks.name: Compute steps run without the pinned options
caught_by: test-normalise.R: compute steps run under the pinned options, whatever the session's

breaks.name: Canonical JSON keeps key order
caught_by: test-normalise.R: canonical JSON drops classes, sorts keys, rounds numbers and keeps array order

breaks.name: Canonical JSON leaves numeric strings unrounded
caught_by: test-normalise.R: canonical JSON rounds decimal strings like numbers and leaves other strings alone

breaks.name: Condition text keeps curly quotes
caught_by: test-type-conditions.R: ANSI codes are removed and curly quotes become straight

breaks.name: Conditions raised while drawing are missed
caught_by: test-type-conditions.R: every condition is captured in order, including those raised while drawing

breaks.name: Returned text drops the names that head each example
caught_by: test-contract.R: returned_text: sensitivity

breaks.name: A human decision for an old fingerprint still counts
caught_by: test-decisions.R: a human decision for an old fingerprint has no effect

breaks.name: Review status ignores human decisions
caught_by: test-check.R: an agent approves a platform variant from a bundle, with a note

breaks.name: An agent command writes the decisions file
caught_by: test-decisions.R: a human rejection needs a note, sets Rejected and holds against the agent

breaks.name: A human approval writes Human approved into review_state.json
caught_by: test-decisions.R: a human approval of the current fingerprint makes it Human approved, in the decisions file only

breaks.name: The server accepts a human rejection without a note
caught_by: test-decisions.R: a human rejection needs a note, sets Rejected and holds against the agent

breaks.name: The server accepts a decision on an output no agent has approved
caught_by: test-decisions.R: a human rejection needs a note, sets Rejected and holds against the agent

breaks.name: The server accepts a decision made on a stale page
caught_by: test-decisions.R: the human can't decide on an output no agent has approved, or on a stale page

breaks.name: A human approval doesn't keep the approved version for comparison
caught_by: test-check.R: the release audit compares fresh views with those kept at approval

breaks.name: The server accepts a decision that isn't JSON
caught_by: test-server.R: only JSON from the page's own origin is accepted

breaks.name: The server accepts a decision from another origin
caught_by: test-server.R: only JSON from the page's own origin is accepted

breaks.name: The server serves files outside its folders
caught_by: test-server.R: nothing outside the page and view folders is served

breaks.name: An inventory ID used twice is accepted
caught_by: test-inventory.R: an inventory with a reused ID, a missing principle or a bad ID is refused

breaks.name: covers() inside a test block is missed
caught_by: test-inventory.R: covers() is read from anywhere in a case file, without running it

breaks.name: The code hash leaves out the cases the unit tests read
caught_by: test-fake-type.R: an unforeseen type goes from run to the review page's data

breaks.name: CI passes Agent approved without a warning
caught_by: test-check.R: CI shows each review status by the approved policy

breaks.name: CI passes an Unreviewed or Rejected output
caught_by: test-check.R: CI shows each review status by the approved policy

breaks.name: A missing input passes the CI check
caught_by: test-check.R: an output the state records but no case produced stops the check

breaks.name: A platform variant still counts after its original changed
caught_by: test-check.R: a variant counts only for its platform, fingerprint and a Human approved original

breaks.name: A platform variant counts for an original that isn't Human approved
caught_by: test-check.R: a variant counts only for its platform, fingerprint and a Human approved original

breaks.name: The release check accepts Agent approved
caught_by: test-check.R: the release check accepts Human approved and its platform variants only

breaks.name: The release audit misses a changed view
caught_by: test-check.R: the release audit compares fresh views with those kept at approval
